skills.name: build
skills.acceptanceOracle: The approved milestone issues and their sealed acceptance tests are authoritative.

skills.name: code-analysis
skills.acceptanceOracle: Every reported defect has an honest failing test followed by a verified fix.

skills.name: code-refactor
skills.acceptanceOracle: The project baseline stays green and observable behaviour does not change.

skills.name: code-review
skills.acceptanceOracle: Every finding is evidence-backed and independently verified before reporting.

skills.name: debug
skills.acceptanceOracle: The known symptom is reproduced, fixed test-first, and verified in the real surface.

skills.name: deploy
skills.acceptanceOracle: The approved release is healthy on its named target and has a tested rollback path.

skills.name: docs
skills.acceptanceOracle: Documentation matches the shipped system and passes the repository documentation standard.

skills.name: jj
skills.acceptanceOracle: The requested VCS state is present and recoverable in the Jujutsu operation log.

skills.name: new-feature
skills.acceptanceOracle: The interviewed feature is implemented against approved, sealed acceptance criteria.

skills.name: perf
skills.acceptanceOracle: The measured improvement exceeds benchmark noise without a correctness regression.

skills.name: plan
skills.acceptanceOracle: The plan is evidence-backed, independently executable, and explicitly approved before reconciliation.

skills.name: repo-setup
skills.acceptanceOracle: The repository can be built, tested, linted, and safely changed by an agent.

skills.name: research
skills.acceptanceOracle: The final packet covers every assigned area with attributable, deduplicated evidence.

skills.name: review-fix-loop
skills.acceptanceOracle: Every blocking finding is fixed or surfaced when the bounded loop stops.

skills.name: use-other-harness
skills.acceptanceOracle: The explicitly requested foreign harness completes one bounded leaf task with the named model and effort.

skills.name: wiki
skills.acceptanceOracle: Only opted-in project knowledge is recorded and immutable evidence is preserved.

agents.name: planner
agents.acceptanceOracle: The plan and issue acceptance tests are complete enough for independent execution.

optionalSurfaces.name: effort
optionalSurfaces.limitationNote: Grok Build does not expose a verified per-agent effort surface; effort stays a headless launch argument.

agents.name: specifier
agents.acceptanceOracle: The assigned issue has honest failing tests sealed on the agreed base.

optionalSurfaces.name: global-skill-invocation
optionalSurfaces.limitationNote: Antigravity ships the jj skill inside this agent rather than in the globally invocable skill family, so /workcell:jj is not offered as a global skill on Antigravity; every other harness offers it globally.

agents.name: builder
agents.acceptanceOracle: The assigned issue passes sealed tests and real-surface verification without changing the oracle.

optionalSurfaces.name: global-skill-invocation
optionalSurfaces.limitationNote: Antigravity ships the jj skill inside this agent rather than in the globally invocable skill family, so /workcell:jj is not offered as a global skill on Antigravity; every other harness offers it globally.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.acceptanceOracle: Every finding is specific, evidenced, scoped, and correctly ranked.

agents.name: integrator
agents.acceptanceOracle: The wave works as one combined change-set on its agreed integration base.

agents.name: researcher
agents.acceptanceOracle: The assigned research area is covered by attributable evidence and explicit uncertainty.

agents.name: documenter
agents.acceptanceOracle: The assigned documentation is current, lean, and mechanically valid.

agents.name: deployer
agents.acceptanceOracle: The named target is healthy after the approved release and rollback remains available.

agents.name: debugger
agents.acceptanceOracle: The reported symptom is reproduced and narrowed experimentally to one root cause.

agents.name: profiler
agents.acceptanceOracle: Performance is reported as a reproducible distribution against the project benchmark harness.
